title: Cheerful Digits
commonMistakes: Squaring the whole number rather than each digit
Forgetting to reset the running sum between steps
Not detecting cycles, causing an infinite loop
Failing to return `true` immediately when the value becomes `1`
followUps: How would you use constant extra space with slow and fast pointers?
How many distinct values can appear after the first step for 32-bit inputs?
How would you find all cheerful numbers up to a large limit efficiently?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
